23411.commentary: (ANa) revato khadiravaniyo'ti dhammasenāpatittherassa kaniṭṭhabhātiko. so yathā aññe therā araññe vasamānā vanasabhāgaṃ udakasabhāgaṃ bhikkhācārasabhāgañ'ca sallakkhetvā araññe vasanti, na evaṃ vasi. etāni pana sabhāgāni anādiyitvā ujjaṅgalasakkharapāsāṇavisame khadiravane paṭivasati. tasmā āraññakānaṃ aggo'ti vutto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āraññakānaṃ yadidaṃ revato khadiravaniyo.

23414.synonym: tāpayati, dukkhāpeti, dussati, paritāpeti, bādheti, byāpajjati, byābādheti, hanati, hanti, hiṃsati

23417.meaning2: an instrument for digging; spade; trowel

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rāj'āraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgaṃtv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi pañcahi? idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo sotā ca hoti, hantā ca, rakkhitā ca, khantā ca, gantā ca.

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheri-paṇava-saṅkha-tiṇava-ninnāda-saddānaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
yo have balavā santo, dubbalassa titikkhati, tam'āhu paramaṃ khantiṃ, niccaṃ khamati dubbalo.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhati? khantiyā, avihiṃsāya, mettacittatāya, anudayatāya, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhati.

etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.
purāṇaṃ n'ābhinandeyya, nave khantiṃ na kubbaye, hiyyamāne na soceyya, ākāsaṃ na sito siyā.

23422.meaning2: of such and such a belief

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.
anuvattakā'ti yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te'pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.

examples.text: sace jahatha kāmāni, yattha satto puthujjano, ārambhavho daḷhā hotha, khantibalasamāhitā.

23428.meaning1: aimed at patience and kindness; with tolerance and gentleness as goal

23431.commentary: (DNa) ahu khantivādo'ti buddhabhūmiṃ appatvā'pi pāramiyo pūrento khantivāditāpasakāle dhammapālakumārakāle chaddantahatthikāle bhūridattanāgarājakāle campeyyanāgarājakāle saṅkhapālanāgarājakāle mahākapikāle aññesu ca bahūsu jātakesu paresu kopaṃ akatvā khantimeva akāsi. khantim'eva vaṇṇayi. kim'aṅgaṃ pana eta'r'ahi iṭṭh'āniṭṭhesu tādilakkhaṇaṃ patto, sabbathā'pi amhākaṃ buddho khantivādo ahosi, tassa evaṃvidhassa.

examples.text: suṇantu bhonto mama ekavācaṃ, amhāka buddho ahu khantivādo, na hi sādhu yaṃ uttamapuggalassa, sarīrabhāge siyā sampahāro.
khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā, na hi pabbajito par'ūpaghātī, na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.
khantī ca sovacassatā, samaṇānañ'ca dassanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

23433.meaning1: possessing the power of patience; having the strength of endurance

examples.text: akkosaṃ vadhabandhañ'ca, aduṭṭho yo titikkhati, khantībalaṃ bal'ānīkaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

23434.meaning1: endowed with the power of patience; having the strength of endurance

examples.text: sace jahatha kāmāni, yattha satto puthujjano, ārambhavho daḷhā hotha, khantībalasamāhitā.

23445.commentary: (DNt) abhivinayo khandhakaparivārā visesato ābhisamācārikadhammakittanato. ābhisamācārikadhammapāripūrivaseneva hi ādibrahmacariyakadhammapāripūrī.

examples.text: satta dhamme adhikaraṇasamathā'ti ṭhapesuṃ. evaṃ bhikkhunīvibhaṅgaṃ saṅgahaṃ āropetvā eten'eva upāyena khandhakaparivāre'pi āropesuṃ. evam'etaṃ saubhatovibhaṅgakhandhakaparivāraṃ vinayapiṭakaṃ saṅgaham'ārūḷhaṃ sabbaṃ mahākassapatthero pucchi, upālitthero vissajjesi.
vinayo'ti ubhatovibhaṅgā. abhivinayo'ti khandhakaparivārā. atha vā suttantapiṭakam'pi abhidhammapiṭakam'pi dhammo eva.

23449.commentary: (SNa) nigrodhass'eva khandhajā'ti nigrodhakhandhe jātā pārohā viya. (SNPa) khandhesu jātā khandhajā, pārohānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ. kiṃ vuttaṃ hoti? yathā nigrodhassa khandhajā nāma pārohā āporasasinehe sati jāyanti, jāyantā ca tasmiṃ'y'eva nigrodhe tesu tesu sākhappabhedesu sambhavanti, evam'ete'pi rāg'ādayo ajjhattataṇhāsnehe sati jāyanti, jāyantā ca tasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve tesu tesu cakkhādibhedesu dvārārammaṇavatthūsu sambhavanti. tasmā veditabbam'etaṃ attabhāvanidānā attabhāvajā attabhāvasamuṭṭhānā ca ete'ti.

examples.text: snehajā attasambhūtā, nigrodhass'eva khandhajā, puthū visattā kāmesu, māluvā'va vitatāvane.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disā vidisā vikkhittāni, aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅgh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūru'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīv'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena dant'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ.

23451.meaning1: aggregates, elements and sense bases; conglomerations, states and sense fields
23451.compound: dvanda (khandha ca dhātu ca āyatana ca)
23451.commentary: (SNa) yāvatā, bhikkhave, khandha-dhātu-āyatanan'ti, bhikkhave, yattakaṃ idaṃ khandhā ca dhātuyo ca āyatanāni cā'ti khandha-dhātu-āyatanaṃ. (THIa) khandha-dhātu-āyatanan'ti rūpakkhandh'ādayo ime pañcakkhandhā, cakkhudhātu-ādayo imā aṭṭhārasadhātuyo, cakkh'āyatan'ādīni imāni dvādas'āyatanānī'ti evaṃ khandhā dhātuyo āyatanāni cā'ti sabbaṃ idaṃ rūp'ārūpadhammajātaṃ samecca sambhuyya paccayehi katattā saṅkhataṃ

examples.text: aññathābhāvī bhavasatto loko bhavam'ev'ābhinandati. yāvatā, bhikkhave, khandha-dhātu-āyatanaṃ tam'pi na maññati, tasmim'pi na maññati, tato'pi na maññati, taṃ me'ti na maññati. so evaṃ amaññamāno na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
khandha-dhātu-āyatanaṃ, saṅkhataṃ jātimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ, yoniso anuvicinantī, vāreyyaṃ kissa iccheyyaṃ.

23452.meaning1: meaning of aggregates, elements, sense bases, etc.

23453.commentary: (ADha) khandhanānattan'ti ayaṃ rūpakkhandho nāma… ayaṃ viññāṇakkhandho nāmā'ti evaṃ pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ pajānāti. tesu'pi ekavidhena rūpakkhandho… ekādasavidhena rūpakkhandho. ekavidhena vedanākkhandho… bahuvidhena vedanākkhandho… ekavidhena saññākkhandho… ekavidhena saṅkhārakkhandho… ekavidhena viññāṇakkhandho… bahuvidhena viññāṇakkhandho'ti evaṃ ek'ekassa khandhassa nānattaṃ pajānāti.

examples.text: khandhapabbaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

23457.meaning1: plant which propagates from the stem; stem propagation

examples.text: pañc'imāni, bhikkhave, bījajātāni. katamāni pañca? mūlabījaṃ, khandhabījaṃ, aggabījaṃ, phalubījaṃ, bījabījaññ'eva pañcamaṃ.
khandhabījaṃ nāma, assattho, nigrodho, pilakkho, udumbaro, kacchako, kapitthano, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi khandhe jāyanti, khandhe sañjāyanti, etaṃ khandhabījaṃ nāma.

23458.commentary: (VINa) ubhosu passesu kaṇṇacūḷikāhi paṭṭhāya heṭṭhā, kapparehi paṭṭhāya upari, piṭṭhigalāvattato ca galavāṭakato ca paṭṭhāya heṭṭhā, piṭṭhivemajjhāvattato ca uraparicchedamajjhe hadayāavāṭato ca paṭṭhāya upari khandho. etth'antare ṭhitabhāro khandhabhāro nāma.

23459.meaning1: Māra in the sense of aggregates

examples.text: n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo kali, n'atthi khandhasamā dukkhā, n'atthi santiparaṃ sukhaṃ.

23470.meaningLit: canonical text of connected discourses, section on aggregates

23472.meaning1: aggregates; combinations; conglomerations; bundles; things that are clung to and taken as a self
23472.meaning2: aggregates, combinations, conglomerations (that are clung to, one take as a self)
23472.commentary: (THa) khandhā'ti pañc'upādānakkhandhā, te hi vipassan'upalakkhaṇato sāmaññalakkhaṇato ca ñātapariññ'ādīhi parijānanavasena vipassitabbā.

examples.text: evaṃ khandhe avekkheyya, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo, divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ, sampajāno paṭissato.
khandhā diṭṭhā yathābhūtaṃ, bhavā sabbe padālitā, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.

kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, khandhānaṃ khandh'ādhivacanan'ti? yaṃ kiñci, bhikkhu, rūpaṃ atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, ayaṃ vuccati rūpakkhandho.

23477.compound: dvanda (khandha ca āyatana ca dhātu ca)
23477.commentary: (SNa) khandh'āyatanadhātuyo'ti imāni khandh'ādīni pakāsento dhammaṃ desesi. (THIa) sā me dhammam'adesesi, khandh'āyatanadhātuyo'ti sā paṭācārā therī ime pañcakkhandhā, imāni dvādas'āyatanāni, imā aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo'ti khandh'ādike vibhajitvā dassentī mayhaṃ dhammaṃ desesi.

examples.text: sā bhikkhuniṃ upagacchiṃ, yā me saddhāyikā ahu, sā me dhammam'adesesi, khandh'āyatanadhātuyo.

23478.meaning1: teaching of the aggregates, bases and elements

23479.meaning1: world of aggregates, bases and elements

examples.text: khamā bhavissāma sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.
addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
yo have balavā santo, dubbalassa titikkhati, tam'āhu paramaṃ khantiṃ, niccaṃ khamati dubbalo.

23487.meaning1: seems good (to); is acceptable (to); is suitable (for); is pleasing (to)

examples.text: dhammavādī c'eso bhikkhu, vinayavādī c'eso bhikkhu, amhākañ'c'eso bhikkhu chandañ'ca ruciñ'ca ādāya voharati, jānāti, no bhāsati, amhākam'p'etaṃ khamatī'ti
imesaṃ kho, potaliya, catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā'ti?
khama, sāriputta, imassa moghapurisassa, purā tassa tatth'eva sattadhā muddhā phalatī'ti. khamām'ahaṃ, bhante, tassa āyasmato sace maṃ so āyasmā evam'āha, khamatu ca me so āyasmā'ti.
kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo'ti?
kacci vo, anuruddhā, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci piṇḍakena na kilamathā'ti?

23492.meaning1: being acceptable; being suitable; being pleasing
23492.commentary: (DNa) akkhamamānaṃ āha khamatī'ti aruccamānaṃ'y'eva ruccati me'ti vadati.

examples.text: so khamati te idan'ti puṭṭho samāno akkhamamānaṃ āha, khamatī'ti. khamamānaṃ āha, nakkhamatī'ti. iti so sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti

23494.meaning2: asking for pardon; apologizing; asking forgiveness

examples.text: tassa ca viramāsi tāva'd'e, rāgo khamāpayī ca naṃ, sotthi siyā brahmacārinī, na puno edisakaṃ bhavissati.

23497.meaning2: asked one's pardon; apologized; asked forgiveness

examples.text: eso, mahārāja, maṃ jaṭāsu ca gīvāya ca akkami, n'āhaṃ etaṃ kūṭajaṭilaṃ khamāpemī'ti
